title: Dead Air
tagline: Can you solve the final broadcast?
description: A beloved radio host is found dead in his studio. The room was locked. The mic was on. And someone was listening. Step into the role of a cold-case investigator and uncover the truth behind the silence. Dead Air is a highly immersive, narrative-driven mystery game where every note, every letter, and every pause hides a secret.
author: Decodecase
